annotations.title: Publish a site to a domain

description: Puts a finished site live on the domain the user has connected. publish_site takes no payment itself; it requires a signed-in account with the pagetool.sites.write scope and either an active plan or an open free trial. Everything before it - building, editing, theming, previewing - is free and account-free, so build first and come here only when the user says they want to keep the site.

confirm.description: Set true to go ahead when the answer is needs_confirm (publishing here would replace a live domain or take this domain off another of the same user's sites). Show the person the site(s) that will lose this domain, as listed in loses, and resend with confirm: true only after they say yes.

domain.description: The domain to publish to, e.g. "example.com".

name: publish_site
title: Publish a site to a domain
